original_statement:
What must hold? State the invariant or expectation this concerns. docs/tasks/E16-adjudicator-hardening.md:27-28 (E16 S6): the adjudicator imports no ERC-4626 interface and calls no exchange rate, and the forge tests check this as a source-level assertion.
What holds now? Describe the current, observed state. On integrated df56543, three checks cover S6. test/SettlementRateFree.t.sol reads the adjudicator artifact's metadata.sources and scans the deployed bytecode for the six ERC-4626 rate selectors. scripts/check-settlement-rate-free.py (oracle of derived-arn-4c3) matches the regex \b(convertToAssets|convertToShares|previewDeposit|previewMint|previewRedeem|previewWithdraw)\s*\( and import lines containing 4626 (lines 35-44). scripts/check-settlement-rate-free-gate.py (oracle of derived-arn-5db) matches the plain substrings ERC4626, IERC4626, convertToAssets, convertToShares and preview (lines 36-42), and skips a file it cannot open (except FileNotFoundError: pass). Both scripts define their own collect_files(), scan_files() and self_test() over src/ArmadaNitroAdjudicator.sol and src/nitro/.
How do you see it? Describe exactly how to observe this for yourself — the steps to reproduce, or how you would demo it. 1. Read scripts/check-settlement-rate-free.py:35-100 and scripts/check-settlement-rate-free-gate.py:36-88 at df56543. 2. Read test/SettlementRateFree.t.sol. 3. Run grep -l check-settlement-rate-free contracts/specs/*.json.
Where does this apply? (e.g. gateway route, mobile screen, CLI verb) scripts/check-settlement-rate-free.py, scripts/check-settlement-rate-free-gate.py, test/SettlementRateFree.t.sol

Decomposed child: scripts/check-settlement-rate-free.py and scripts/check-settlement-rate-free-gate.py each define their own collect_files(), scan_files() and self_test(). Both sets of functions scan src/ArmadaNitroAdjudicator.sol and src/nitro/. check-settlement-rate-free.py is the oracle of derived-arn-4c3. check-settlement-rate-free-gate.py is the oracle of derived-arn-5db. Remove the duplication between the two scripts. Make the two scripts share one implementation of collect_files(), scan_files(), and self_test(), instead of each script keeping its own copy. Keep each script's own distinct detection logic unchanged. check-settlement-rate-free.py matches the regex \b(convertToAssets|convertToShares|previewDeposit|previewMint|previewRedeem|previewWithdraw)\s*\( and import lines that contain 4626, at lines 35-44. check-settlement-rate-free-gate.py matches the plain substrings ERC4626, IERC4626, convertToAssets, convertToShares and preview, at lines 36-42.
